name: Ririka
source:
The youngest of the girls working for the sex industry as a hostess or fuuzokujou. She goes by the name of Ririka in her workplace. Because she looks the youngest, Ririka generally takes the role of a spoiled little sister. She has a boyfriend who lives with her ([url=/c100280]Tooru[/url]) who also pimps her.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20060207232233/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/hansoku.htm]Official Website[/url].]
